name: marketing_skills_for_AI_agents
description: A comprehensive skillset repository providing marketing capabilities tailored for Claude Code and AI agents, covering CRO, copywriting, SEO, analytics, and growth engineering.

inputs.name: marketing_goal
inputs.description: The specific marketing objective or area of focus (e.g., improve conversion rate, generate SEO optimized content).

inputs.name: target_audience
inputs.description: Description of the intended audience or customer segment.

inputs.name: content_parameters
inputs.description: Settings or guidelines related to copywriting or content creation including tone, style, and keywords.

inputs.name: analytics_data
inputs.description: Collected internal or external data relevant to marketing performance analysis.

outputs.name: optimized_copy
outputs.description: Generated or refined marketing copy optimized for conversion and engagement.

outputs.name: seo_recommendations
outputs.description: SEO strategies and suggestions to improve search engine ranking and visibility.

outputs.name: growth_reports
outputs.description: Analytical reports identifying growth opportunities and performance insights.

outputs.name: conversion_strategies
outputs.description: Actionable tactics and engineering practices aimed at improving conversion rates.

patterns: SEO keyword targeting and content structuring
Integration of multiple marketing disciplines for holistic strategies
steps: Receive marketing objective and audience parameters
Analyze existing performance data and current marketing assets
Generate or optimize copywriting content tailored to audience and goal
Develop SEO strategies aligned with target keywords and search trends
Create analytics-driven reports highlighting action points for growth
Iterate and refine strategies based on ongoing analytics feedback
use_cases: Enhancing website conversion rates through AI-generated CRO tactics
Creating SEO-optimized content for improved organic search performance
Generating compelling marketing copy tailored to specific demographics
Performing growth engineering analysis to identify scalable opportunities
Integrating AI agents into marketing workflows to automate strategy development

prompt_templates.name: generate_marketing_copy
prompt_templates.template: Generate a persuasive marketing copy targeting {target_audience} aimed at achieving {marketing_goal} with tone and style {content_parameters}.

prompt_templates.name: seo_strategy_suggestion
prompt_templates.template: Provide SEO recommendations to improve ranking for keywords related to {marketing_goal} targeting {target_audience}.

prompt_templates.name: growth_analysis_report
prompt_templates.template: Analyze the following analytics data and create a growth report with actionable insights: {analytics_data}.

prompt_templates.name: conversion_rate_optimization_plan
prompt_templates.template: Develop a conversion rate optimization strategy based on current data and focus on the goal: {marketing_goal}.
